archetypes.name: lib-api-surface
archetypes.rationale: The plan names specific library functions (codex_launcher_record_usage_from_events, external_launcher_record_usage_from_events, emit_kv) and prescribes which lib files to source at each of 3 sites; if any name or source path is wrong the implementation silently compiles but produces no telemetry or incorrect error output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every library function referenced in the plan actually exists with the exact name and signature given: `codex_launcher_record_usage_from_events` in `lib-codex-launcher-common.sh`, `external_launcher_record_usage_from_events` in `lib-external-launcher-common.sh`, and `emit_kv` in whatever lib file `get-issue-state.sh` sources. Check that the plan's chosen lib-source for each of the three Item B sites (review-and-fix.sh, lint-fix-loop.sh, run-negotiation-round.sh) matches which lib is already in scope vs which requires a new `source` line. Confirm the calling convention (argument order and types) matches the actual function signatures for the telemetry-record calls. Flag any name/signature mismatch as a plan defect — a wrong function name will not error at shell parse time and will silently skip telemetry. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: glob-pattern-logic
archetypes.rationale: The entire Item B naming decision pivots on whether `-events.jsonl` (hyphen) escapes the `*.events.jsonl` (dot) wildcard exclusion in larch-log.sh; if the plan's reasoning about that glob is wrong the new artifacts will be silently dropped from run-logs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the actual `case` statement ordering inside `round_artifact_included` in `scripts/larch-log.sh`: confirm the exclusion wildcard at the plan's cited line 70 requires a literal dot before `events` and would NOT match a hyphen-separated name like `coder-codex-events.jsonl`. Verify that the include alternation at line 89 is structurally reachable AFTER the exclusion arms — i.e., the case statement allows a later pattern to override, or the include arm appears before the exclusion arm. Check whether `scout-archetype-yield.tsv` is currently hit by any deny pattern in lines 70-87 that could suppress it before reaching line 89. Confirm the plan's claim that `*.tsv` is not in the default deny. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
